title: fix(app-shell): the dashboard's Add-widget menu and widget Type select offer every spec widget type, from one registry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AjnN3rHbxAJgDGvm5z2nh4)_

Fixes #26745

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:仪表盘的「添加组件」菜单和组件检查器的「类型」下拉,改为读同一个注册表,而注册表的类型集合直接取自 spec 的 `ChartTypeSchema`;两处都从 11/10 种变成 spec 的全部 20 种。补了新类型的中英文名称,并改写了指向不存在控件的数据集提示文案。
- 为什么改:两个选择器各自手写清单,互相不一致,也和 spec 不一致,9 种平台能渲染的图表在 Studio 里没有入口。页面 block 选择器缺的 8 个经实测全部是有书面理由的排除,本 PR 不动。
- 风险与回滚:只改 Studio 编辑器提供的选项和文案,渲染器与 spec 词汇原样不动;两个选择器的排列改为 spec 顺序。有问题直接 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`previews/widget-types.ts` 的 `WIDGET_TYPE_IDS` 与 `WIDGET_TYPE_PRESENTATION`(`satisfies`),然后 `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx` 的 `WIDGET_TYPES`,最后 `AddWidgetPicker.oneRegistry-26745.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AddWidgetPicker.oneRegistry-26745.test.tsx`,预期 7 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Base `aa00362f`.

- **`previews/widget-types.ts` is the one registry.** The offered set is `WIDGET_TYPE_IDS = ChartTypeSchema.options`, read from `@objectstack/spec/ui` at runtime (the module's consumers already load `@objectstack/spec/ui`), so the file restates no list of type names. What stays per type is presentation (English `label`, the two catalogue keys, category, icon) in `WIDGET_TYPE_PRESENTATION`, checked with `satisfies Record<ChartType, …>`: a type the spec adds or retires fails `tsc` until its row is added or removed. `WIDGET_TYPE_META` and `WIDGETS_BY_CATEGORY` keep their shapes, so `AddWidgetPicker`, `DashboardDefaultInspector` and `DashboardPreview` read the registry unchanged.
- **`inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`.** The Type select's hand-kept `WIDGET_TYPES` list (10 entries, no `scatter`) is replaced by a map over `WIDGET_TYPE_IDS`, labelled from the registry's `selectLabelKey`. The docblock that said "A hand-written SUBSET is fine" now says the opposite.
- **Newly offered types:** `column`, `scatter` (Type select only; the menu already had it), `treemap`, `sankey`, `combo`, `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `kpi`, `bullet`, `radar`. `list` and `custom` stay out: they are objectui-only families with no `ChartTypeSchema` member, so a widget authored with them cannot publish.
- **i18n (`studio` namespace, en + zh).** `engine.inspector.widget.type.*` for the ten types the Type select did not name; `engine.widgetPicker.type.*` for the nine the Add menu did not name. No row in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` is added or edited (the dispatch's shared-file rule while #26942 is open). `engine.inspector.widget.datasetHint` is reworded in en and zh: it no longer points at "the inline object query above", which the inspector has not drawn since ADR-0021, and describes the dataset, dimension and measure controls it does draw.
- **Page block palette: no change.** Measured against `PageComponentType` (34 types) on `aa00362f`: the palette offers 26, and the 8 it does not offer are exactly the 8 entries of `PALETTE_EXCLUSIONS`, each with a recorded reason. Per the dispatch, a block excluded with a recorded reason stays excluded:
  - `record:chatter`: compatibility alias of the offered `record:discussion` (maintainer ruling on objectui#5495).
  - `app:launcher`, `global:notifications`: shell singletons, not page content.
  - `element:record_picker`, `element:text_input`: render, but are field widgets, not page blocks.
  - `record:approvals`, `record:attachments`, `record:approval_decision`: render; recorded as "not yet offered, offering it is a Studio decision". Left for that decision (see the report's open question).
- Changeset: patch for `@object-ui/i18n`; `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.

## Tests

`previews/AddWidgetPicker.oneRegistry-26745.test.tsx`, seven cases, each read off the rendered control:

- the spec enum reads non-empty (the non-vacuity duty of `enumOptions`);
- the registry equals `ChartTypeSchema`'s vocabulary, in the spec order;
- the Add-widget menu lists exactly the spec types (read from each entry's stored-type `code`);
- the Type select lists exactly the spec types, each named by its registry key;
- every offered type renders through the real `DashboardRenderer` (via `DashboardPreview`), with no "not supported yet" placeholder and no red unknown-component panel;
- control: the same probe sees the placeholder for `heatmap`, a family with no renderer;
- every type has both names in en and zh, and the Add menu's en name equals the English `label` the default title is written from.

`inspectorStrings.i18n-10804` and `inspectorStrings.i18n-10748` used hand-kept type lists of their own; both now read the registry, so their per-type zh/en checks cover all 20 types.

Ablations (both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

- Type select given back a hand-kept 10-type list: the Type select case goes red (1 failed, 6 passed).
- Add menu registry given back a hand-kept 11-type list: the registry, Add menu and Type select cases go red (3 failed, 4 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- The two catalogue families name each type differently ("Bar chart" in the menu, "Bar Chart" in the select; "Data table" vs "Table"). Collapsing them to one family is a naming decision this card does not make; the menu's older rows still live in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and move with #25922.
- Both pickers now follow the spec's order. The menu still groups by category, so its "Single value" group opens with `gauge` instead of `metric`, and the select lists `bar` first instead of `metric`.
- A widget added from the menu is titled `New TYPE` from the English `label`, as before; the new types get `New column chart`, `New treemap` and so on.
